batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2022-2023, Set-N as printed in the compilation header (the second A paper in the PDF; assignment suggested Set-II but the printed header reads সেট-N) — transcribed from the publisher question-bank PDF compilation (Medistry/Udvash) distributed via AdmissionWar/TargetPDF. Printed publisher answer keys ([Ans: x] markers and সমাধান: (x) lines) are preserved as-is; they are NOT official JU keys. All questions carry contentVerificationStatus unverified pending later cross-source verification. Q50 is absent from the scanned compilation pages (PDF pp.16-17 jump from Q49 to Q51) and is therefore not included; the unnumbered 'Extra Syllabus' item after Q80 on PDF p.19 is not part of the numbered 80-question paper and is also excluded. Cross-source verification 2026-10-31 vs Satt Academy: 59 of 79 questions publicly comparable; 53 content-verified and included in the import-ready copy. All 53 comparable publisher answer keys agree (0 conflicts). Five questions are unkeyed in both sources (ICT 10 unknown; ICT 14, Higher Mathematics 35, Physics 49, Chemistry 60 are printed as no-correct-option in the compilation — a primary-source claim, consistently unkeyed on Satt). 26 questions remain content-unverified (6 with documented disputes: ICT 10 and Chemistry 68 option order, Chemistry 59 option d, Chemistry 75 stem, Chemistry 78 option c, Higher Mathematics 36 option a; 20 not publicly readable on Satt) and are excluded from the import-ready copy; they remain in the archived full pack. Printed Q50 is absent from the compilation scan and was not publicly readable on Satt; it remains missing — no question was fabricated. Detail: VERIFICATION/SOURCE_EVIDENCE/ju-a-2022-2023-setn.VERIFICATION.md.

sourceDocuments.title: JU A Unit question & solution 2022-2023 (Set-N), publisher question-bank compilation via AdmissionWar/TargetPDF
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned compilation PDF (29 pp., all JU A sets for 2022-2023). Set-N occupies PDF pages 11-19 (book pages 11-19). Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image; tesseract (ben+eng) OCR used only as a draft and corrected against the images. Mathematical notation linearized with ^ for superscripts. Original PDF retained in RESEARCH_ARCHIVE.
